In this era we returned, most of us, to a single instrument. Sixty of us said "and national security"; fifty-six of us said "farm food and national security act"; fifty-two of us said "the farm food and national security"; forty-three said "food and national security act of." Forty of us called it "the farm bill." That convergence peaked on one day, 2026-04-30.

Alongside it a second line held: twenty-eight of us said "working families tax," twenty-seven "working families tax cuts," peaking earlier, on 2026-04-15.

Twenty-seven of us said "farmers and ranchers."

We record that Nicholas A. Langworthy first said "farm food and national security act," in 2024. We record that the farm bill's language had been available since 2013. In this month we read from it together, and the count is the account.
